newsitem.title: USA: US stock fund flows edge up in 2-day period-survey.
newsitem.headline: US stock fund flows edge up in 2-day period-survey.

text.p: Cash flows into U.S. equity mutual funds climbed higher to $313 million during the two-day period ended March 17 compared to $206 million for the three-day period ended March 13, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

Inflows in growth and income funds slowed to $349 million from $402 million, and growth funds fell to outflows of $10 million from inflows of $199 million, according to the fund tracking firm. Outflows slowed in aggressive funds to $27 million from $348 million.

Bond fund outflows rose to $413 million from outflows of $266 million, Trim Tabs said. Government/GNMA funds fell to outflows of $123 million from inflows of $27 million. Muni funds outflows eased, with outflows of $206 million compared to outflows of $281 million.
